notes: Shopify store fronted by Searchspring. Category tree taken from the mega-menu and the /pages/lighting, /pages/decor and /pages/kitchen-table hub pages. Qty = Searchspring pagination.totalResults for bgfilter.collection_handle=<handle>, i.e. the number the PLP itself reports. Shopify /collections.json products_count was rejected: it is consistently higher (it counts unpublished/out-of-stock items) and its implied page count contradicts the page's own data-total-pages. Every one of the 69 rows was cross-checked: ceil(totalResults/96) == the data-total-pages the collection page renders (96 = the page's default 'Show' size). Excluded per scope: furniture, rugs, textiles/bedding/pillows, office, bathroom fittings, kids & baby, pets, clocks, fans, flatware, cookware, kitchen tools, wallpaper, storage bins, and all brand/designer, sale, new-arrival and best-seller listings.
